summary: Slack collection reads, archive sync, offline reports and MCP must share verified workspace/conversation/message identity, canonical current state and scope-owned pagination.
reason: Slack envelopes and overlapping endpoints cannot be safely cached through generic timestamp-only resource extraction; losing request identity or trusting suffix cursors causes collisions, omissions and false completeness. Preserve verified backup/quarantine recovery and atomic page/checkpoint commits on regeneration. Preserve inclusive range endpoints through time fallback, traversal-wide retention evidence, resource-scoped directory checkpoints and validation of concurrent backup winners.
validated_outcome: Fixtures verify real envelopes, observer isolation, WAL-safe migration including a forced concurrent schema-4 to schema-5 race, edits/tombstones, cancelled/reopened thread pagination with empty pages and expired cursor replay, capped directory resume, durable retention limits, exact inclusive history fallback, retained-root discovery and CLI/typed/command MCP collection parity with interchangeable default local cursors.
